independent_acceptance_claim_checks.scope: Focused independent verification of existing Problems 1-5 only; no new whole-paper review.

checks.reason: The full C_free definition on pp.30-32 imposes no intermediate scaling bound beyond embedding and bottom conditions. The increasing cubic and its relative convex-combination family satisfy those hypotheses; the formula on the actually viewed p.33 reaches 47r/45. The proposed positive affine rescaling remains an embedding, has range [-r,0], converges in spatial C-infinity, and fixes standard boundary collars. Its claimed repair is correctly limited to the normalized local step. The explicit Prop.7.4 use on p.34 establishes the core dependency.

Section6 expressly allows a general orientable Riemannian 3-manifold and Heegaard surface (p.21); (6.1) quantifies over every smooth closed surface (p.22). The product-metric graph has projected varifold mass one and unbounded area excess. The degree-one lower bound needed in (6.4) follows separately from the round-Clifford projection Jacobian; the report does not claim the oscillatory examples are F-close.

Lemma6.4 has only closeness, but requires literal boundary equality; the parallel Clifford torus has different area from every isometric orbit member. Proposition6.5 explicitly adds the missing boundary membership, bounding the impact.

The p.30 domain imposes global Emb0 membership and essentiality, not positive tube homology. The U(2) swap descends for central L(3,1), is ambient-isotopic to identity and reverses the torus class; Prop.7.2 expressly includes k=0. The obstruction is to the excess orientation component; the report separately limits the intended oriented use.

Pages6-7 define the orbit as a quotient of the connected identity group and then give two points for q!=1. Connectedness alone rules this out; formal orientations describe a different space. The report correctly confines the issue to the orbit/component convention.
